target_customer: Sales teams selling to local businesses, such as commercial real estate, retail leasing, business brokers and insurance agencies
problem: Standard sales data tools rely on LinkedIn, which few local business owners use, so reps struggle to find and reach them; Resquared provides a local business database with outreach automation.
product_category: Sales prospecting and outreach for local businesses

founders.name: Griffin Morris
founders.background_notes: VentureBeat: started career selling door to door to local businesses in St. Louis, then moved into product management.

founders.name: Tyler Carlson
founders.background_notes: VentureBeat: worked with brick-and-mortar franchises such as Subway and Burger King to modernize stores with technology.

competitors.name: ZoomInfo
competitors.what: B2B contact data and sales intelligence; VentureBeat says it relies on LinkedIn data that few local owners use

technical_complexity.rationale: Data aggregation of local business records and email workflow tooling; the hard part was data quality and deliverability, later adding AI outreach.

defensibility.rationale: A curated database of 11 to 14 million local businesses helps, but data vendors and CRMs can add similar coverage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquired or copied it as of the 2024 seed coverage; VentureBeat says it positions against CRM suites.

market_need_then: Local businesses account for a large share of US firms yet were poorly covered by LinkedIn based prospecting tools, according to company copy; no dated 2021 evidence of spend was found.

branding.domain_note: Company site is re2.ai, a shortened form; the original resquared domain status was not found.

identity.visual_style: SaaS marketing site with customer logos from commercial real estate
identity.voice_and_tone: Practical sales enablement voice with free courses, playbooks and a Selling Local podcast

branding.brand_signature: Selling Local content series and playbooks

rebrands.why: Not stated; appears to be a shortened brand on the website while YC lists Resquared

branding.community_and_virality: Runs a podcast and free courses for local sellers per VentureBeat; no fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is awkward to spell and the site uses a different short form, though content marketing builds some niche awareness.

outcome_analysis: Resquared, a Winter 2021 company founded by a former door to door local sales rep and a franchise technology worker, stayed active and raised a $5M seed in July 2024 led by SNR, with no earlier institutional round found. It reports 2,000 plus teams on the platform, while its small raise three years after the batch suggests slow venture scale growth.
notes: Aggregators disagree on the seed lead (Extruct lists Y Combinator) and on headquarters (Philadelphia per YC, San Francisco per CB Insights and VCBacked, Cincinnati in one profile); YC's Philadelphia is used. CB Insights shows total $5.13M over 2 rounds, implying a small 2021 round, not itemized. The competitor entry is from a 2024 article, not from 2021, and is included because ZoomInfo is the incumbent the article names; no 2021 dated competitor source was found by search (results were 2025 to 2026 listicles). Founder education not found. Brand name origin not found.
